items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who would you say would play with more feelings? Bike and Piku or Big Arui? Bike. Bike. [INTERVIEWEE] Bike. Bike.

ctx.x: Louis was a speller. He wasn't a good reader? No. He was speller. Piku, George, and all of them was readers. But Louis wasn't? Louis was. Louis would spell a whole lot. He couldn't really make a full line. He couldn't take a piece of music up and go down with it. He'd take a piece of music, look at it, run over it, and then he'd go down with it.
Who would you say would play with more feelings? Bike and Piku or Big Arui? Bike. Bike.
